# Skyes Over London / SOLEnterprises

Skyes Over London / SOLEnterprises is the public legal and communications center for Skyes Over London LC. It covers legal terms, privacy, AI product terms, SaaS terms, communications, SMS consent, commerce, media, logistics, developer, security, data processing, and dispute policies.

Important pages:
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/terms/
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/privacy/
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/ai-terms/
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/sms-communications/
- https://solenterprises.org/legal/dmca-ip/
- https://solenterprises.org/contact/

SMS program:
Users may opt in through the contact form, by texting the business number, by calling and requesting follow-up, by booking a service, or by requesting customer support. Messages may include appointment confirmations, missed-call follow-ups, service updates, support replies, account notifications, and help requests. Users may reply STOP to unsubscribe or HELP for help. SMS consent is not sold or shared for third-party marketing.

AI disclosure:
Some services may use AI, automation, agents, generated content, or model routing. AI outputs require human review before reliance.
